feeds.title: Miami Art Scene
feeds.description: Miami Art Scene is an Art Magazine and an influential visual arts portal covering local, national and international art news and information. The platform is deeply immersed within the global art community. Our mission is to promote, develop and support artists, art venues, creative entities, and the arts.

feeds.title: Live Arts Miami Blog
feeds.description: The Culture Chronicles by Live Arts Miami blog is a premier digital platform for staging contemporary debates, dialogues, and conversations on and off the live art stage.
